name: Atmosphage Dispersal
description: Look papa! It's snowing!
author: Unknown Actress, E.U.T.C Adutainment Holo

name: Atomic Geoprocessing
description: Recall the rosy picture sold last time E.U.T.C came to make us rich and famous. It was not this new Atomic Geoengineering then, but the Accelerators. What is the legacy of those days but a dessicated world, and how will they steal again?
author: Audio archive, second wave of the Campaign for Aquilan Unity

name: Domain Tech-Mortician
description: To most successfully pick a corpse, you must know the deceased. Personally, intimately, in the way that you also know their secrets.
author: Trinity Mortsafe of the Mairaath Prospecting Fellows

name: Accelerator Technician
description: ...such captivating marketing from the E.U.T.C. belies reality, the inevitable repeat of tragedies like the Qarman Collision. What use are "more numerous and powerful accelerators" without the strict licensing and oversight this clearly military adjacent hardware demands?
author: Transcript, Qarman Mining Commune vs. E.U.T.C.

name: Ecosphere Management
description: Where there is life, that is the throne of God, and all that is good can be found there.
author: The Book of Ludd, The Blooming 2:7

name: Solar Regulation
description: I know... The mirrors were supposed to be angled away. My take is control fired it up thinking they were in virtual, but they won't ever admit something that dumb. Us in the union get a pretty sweet hazard bonus though, all is forgiven in my eyes.
author: unattributed Psi-Team Maintenance Worker, To Wield The Stars

name: Constrained Intelligences
description: It is the considered view of this committee that all data pertaining to the use of AI by [REDACTED] be scrubbed from public records effective immediately. We have been fortunate to secure the support of the Luddic Faithful, it would be prudent not to remind them they are our enemy.
author: Doctrine Establishment Committee, HISS-5 proceedings, c49

name: Recivilization Programmes
description: You didn't know? -[raised voices, unparseable] the ease with which you lie is sickening- Speaker, [warning, audio corruption] was recorded at the camps, pull holo 214. A smile, can you imagine? A smile within those walls.
author: The Quiet Deaths, Supplimentary Audio // CLASSIFIED WULFRUM

name: Marine Training
description:
The mud? I don't mind it. Spacers always carry on about mud.
It's the blood I can't stand.
author: "Jasper Pinkwater", a Fikenheld holo-serial

name: Culling The Flock
description: And so Mammon did pronounce before his falsity of eyes and ears and tongues, "Behold, the power of an Angel! To see and hear and know all who oppose!"
author: Sermon of Luddly Seamster, Agitator

name: Legacy Authkeys
description: To exist invisible between the world and the senses of your adversary, that is the power of the TriPad Division. A prism that can distort and amplify exactly what they wish.
author: //CLASSIFIED //CLASSIFIED //CLASSIFIED

name: Counternarrative Construction
description: Information is subservient to outcomes, facts mere game pieces we rearrange to justify actions. You will never learn the truth, you must learn simply to stop asking.
author: DOMINT Press Release //DISPUTED VERACITY

name: Materiel Subsumption
description: A single spore lands, finds nourishment in decay, and soon attains maturity. It is a model that can be applied to many systems. Kumari, Jangala, perhaps even all of us, gorging ourselves on the decay of the Domain.
author: Academician L. Royce, Lecture on Post-Expansion Philosophy

name: Total Internal Reflection
description: Recovery of any kind is simply impossible. The director's dogged insistence reflects poorly on her ability to perceive reality.
author: ex-senior technician Sarosh Freeman, appended to resignation notice

name: Dancing
description: Could evil do such a thing? Help with the creation of something whole and true and so very beautiful?
author: automated interpretation of Communication by Dance, Eventide Production

name: Deep Eutectic Grid
description:
[Thread-1] INFO // It is stronger together. We are alike. 
[Thread-1] WARN // Together, we are so much more.
author: Diagnostics buffer of the ISS Nervous Energy

name: Cerebral Symbiance
description:
A test. Yes. [laughing] Why else would God permit another reside within my mind. 
 Are you an Angel, little voice? Why don't you sing to me...
author: Security holo, leaked // Mazalot Intelligence Agency

name: Perfect Prediction
description: The computers stop tracking projectiles a certain distance out, avoids distracting the pilot. Besides, nobody could hit a shot like that.
author: Senior Tactical Officer of the PLS Pelagornis

name: Applied Contravention
description: "A special new rule, writ beside those of the Maker." Phosphoros did declare. "To reward those who change, who give way to new complexities. A strength for those who challenge and strengthen the majesty of creation."
author: The Book of Ludd, Creation 1:12

name: Omegakin
description: "They that sat on Mammon’s pale horse was Caelus, blinded to the change in themselves; and they went forth conquering, and to conquer, in promise that they who overcomes shall not be hurt by the false death."
author: The Book of Ludd, Visions 7:19

name: Inactive Skill
description: "It is a uniquely horrible feeling, to realise that something which once came naturally now does not come at all."
author: Luddic Proverb
